name: MagnaTagATune
description: A music audio dataset containing approximately 25,863 29-second clips from the Magnatune collection, annotated with tags by users of the TagATune game; commonly used for music auto-tagging research.
citation: Law, E., West, K., Mandel, M. I., Bay, M., & Ector, G. (2009). Evaluation of algorithms using games: The case of music tagging. Proceedings of the 10th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR 2009), 387–392. https://ismir2009.ismir.net/proceedings/OS7-1.pdf

license.notes: The upstream dataset site does not identify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. Treat the audio recordings and annotations as having separate rights where applicable; consult upstream terms and obtain permission before redistribution or other use that requires rights clearance.
